control_device_fabrication: The device achieved a remarkable PCE of 15.876%, with a VOC of 1.0304 V, JSC of 20.871 mA/cm², and FF of 73.822%. The composition of the 1.73 mol/L perovskite film is Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1. The SAM consisting of Me-2PACz (0.33 mg/mL) was subsequently added into the perovskite solution to enhance interfacial properties and optimize device performance. To prepare the precursor solution with MACl (0.3 mg/mL), the additive was added to the precursor solution. The perovskite solutions were spin-coated onto the substrate at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s. Then, with 6 s of spin time remaining, CB (160 µL) was slowly dispensed onto the middle of the substrate. After the whole spin-coating process, the substrate was annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
target_device_fabrication: The champion target devices showed a JSC of 23.8181 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.09308 V, and a FF of 74.5111%, resulting in a PCE of 19.3991%. The 1.73 mol/L perovskite solution (Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1) was prepared, shaken overnight to fully dissolve, and then used to prepare perovskite films. Controlled addition of Me-2PACz (0.33 mg/mL) as a SAM was performed to stabilize the perovskite layer and engineer a more robust interface. 0.3 mg/mL PMACl was added into the mixed perovskite solution. The as prepared perovskite precursor was spin-coated onto the substrates at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s, respectively. During the spin-coating process, 160 µL of CB as anti-solvent was quickly dropped onto the samples at the end of 6 s. The film was immediately annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
